questions.title: OVER Clause Basics
questions.description: In ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY finish_seconds), what does the OVER clause do?
questions.Option3: Defines the window (ordering/partitioning) the function computes over

questions.title: Window Versus GROUP BY
questions.description: Unlike GROUP BY, window functions:
questions.Option1: Collapse rows into one per group
questions.Option2: Keep every row while adding per-window values

questions.title: ROW_NUMBER Guarantee
questions.description: What does ROW_NUMBER() guarantee?
questions.Option2: Distinct consecutive numbers 1,2,3,... regardless of ties

questions.title: RANK Tie Behavior
questions.description: Two rows tie for first place. What does RANK() give them, and what does the third row get?

questions.title: DENSE_RANK Tie Behavior
questions.description: Two rows tie for rank 1. What rank does the next row get under DENSE_RANK()?

questions.title: PARTITION BY Effect
questions.description: PARTITION BY category in a window:
questions.Option3: Splits the computation per category, restarting values like row numbers in each partition

questions.title: LAG Meaning
questions.description: LAG(finish_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY finish_seconds) returns:
questions.Option2: The previous row's value in the window order

questions.title: LEAD Boundary Snippet
questions.description: What does next_sec show for the LAST row of this result?

questions.title: NTILE(4) Meaning
questions.description: NTILE(4) OVER (...):
questions.Option1: Divides rows into 4 roughly equal buckets labelled 1..4

questions.title: Running Total Snippet
questions.description: What does the running_total column compute?
questions.Option1: The whole table's sum on every row
questions.Option3: The accumulating sum from the window start through the current row

questions.title: Default Frame And Peers
questions.description: With SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY sec) and two rows tied on sec, what does the default RANGE frame include for each tied row?
questions.Option1: Only the rows strictly before the tie
questions.Option2: All peers of the current row — tied rows share the same running total

questions.title: Window In WHERE
questions.description: WHERE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) = 1 — why does this fail?
questions.Option2: Window functions cannot be evaluated in WHERE — use a CTE or subquery to filter on the number
questions.Option3: It runs but returns all rows

questions.title: Partition Row Number Snippet
questions.description: What does the pos column do in this query?
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY category
  ORDER BY finish_seconds) AS pos
FROM results;

questions.title: COUNT OVER Empty Spec
questions.description: COUNT(*) OVER () computes:
questions.Option1: The count of the whole result set, repeated on every row
questions.Option2: The count of the current row only
questions.Option3: An error — OVER needs ORDER BY

questions.title: RANK Versus ROW_NUMBER Snippet
questions.description: Two rows tie for the fastest time. What do the two columns show for them?

questions.title: LEAD Versus LAG
questions.description: LEAD(finish_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY finish_seconds) returns:
questions.Option2: The following row's value in the window order

questions.title: NTILE Distribution Snippet
questions.description: Nine rows are fed to NTILE(4). How are the bucket sizes distributed?
questions.Option4: 3,2,2,2 — earlier buckets get the extra rows

questions.title: Window Function In CTE Snippet
questions.description: What does this statement return?
questions.Option2: An error — WHERE cannot see rn
questions.codesnippet:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY finish_seconds) AS rn
  FROM results)
SELECT name FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3;

questions.title: RANK After Three Way Tie
questions.description: Three rows tie for rank 1. What rank does the fourth row get under RANK()?

questions.title: Why Alias Window Columns
questions.description: Why should every window expression get an explicit alias (AS pos)?
questions.Option2: Aliases are forbidden on window functions
questions.Option4: Unnamed window expressions get ugly expression-text headers, and downstream clauses need clean column names
